-- (2026-10-22 UI polish, M6-A) minOutline(label, stroke, th): the ScaledSize stroke th (a share of the label's shorter
-- side) is raised to at least MIN_OUTLINE base px, re-checked when the label's size changes (event-driven, nothing per
-- frame). A script that sets the stroke's Thickness itself keeps its value as the new share.
BrickUI.MIN_OUTLINE = 2.5
local function outlineScale()
	local vp = BrickUI.viewportSize()
	if not viewportReady(vp) then return 1 end
	return math.max(0.52, math.min(vp.X / 1050, vp.Y / 620))
end
function BrickUI.minOutline(t, s, th)
	if not IS_CLIENT then return s end
	local base, writing = th, false
	local function fit()
		local a = t.AbsoluteSize
		local m = math.min(a.X, a.Y)
		if m <= 0 then return end
		writing = true
		s.Thickness = math.max(base, BrickUI.MIN_OUTLINE * outlineScale() / m)
		writing = false
	end
	s:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Thickness"):Connect(function() if not writing then base = s.Thickness fit() end end)
	t:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"):Connect(fit)
	fit()
	return s
end

------------------------------------------------------------------ (2026-10-22 UI polish, M7) tap areas
-- tapArea(button, onActivate, minPx): an invisible TextButton BEHIND the button (a sibling, ZIndex - 1), centred on it,
-- never smaller than minPx x minPx SCREEN px (default 44 = 44 pt on a phone). Taps on the button itself still reach the
-- button (its press / hover feel stays); taps on the extension call onActivate. Follows the button's size, position
-- and visibility. Works under any UIScale (the size is a factor of the button's own UDim2).
function BrickUI.tapArea(button, onActivate, minPx)
	minPx = minPx or 44
	local hit = Instance.new("TextButton")
	hit.Name = button.Name .. "TapArea"
	hit.Text = ""
	hit.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	hit.AutoButtonColor = false
	hit.Selectable = false
	hit.AnchorPoint = button.AnchorPoint
	hit.ZIndex = math.max(1, button.ZIndex - 1)
	local ar = button:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIAspectRatioConstraint")
	if ar then ar:Clone().Parent = hit end
	local function fit()
		local a = button.AbsoluteSize
		hit.Visible = button.Visible
		hit.Position = button.Position
		hit.Rotation = button.Rotation
		if a.X <= 0 or a.Y <= 0 then return end
		local s = button.Size
		local fx, fy = math.max(1, minPx / a.X), math.max(1, minPx / a.Y)
		hit.Size = UDim2.new(s.X.Scale * fx, s.X.Offset * fx, s.Y.Scale * fy, s.Y.Offset * fy)
	end
	for _, prop in {"AbsoluteSize", "Position", "Visible", "Size"} do button:GetPropertyChangedSignal(prop):Connect(fit) end
	hit.Activated:Connect(function() onActivate() end)
	hit.Parent = button.Parent
	fit()
	return hit
end
